original_question: Let Omega in C^n be a bounded biholomorphic image of the unit ball in C^n . Does the d-bar satisfy uniform estimates on Omega? The problem is of interest mainly when Omega has very rough boundary.
target_in_paper: An unlabeled open problem in The Several Complex Variables Problem List asking whether the ̄∂-problem enjoys uniform estimates on bounded domains in ℂ^n that are biholomorphic images of the unit ball, especially when the boundary is very rough.
correct_elements: Your draft captures the apparent mathematical core of the problem very well: the domain Ω is a bounded biholomorphic image of the unit ball in ℂ^n; the issue concerns uniform estimates for the ̄∂-operator/̄∂-equation on Ω; and the motivation is precisely the difficult case of highly irregular boundary.
missing_details: The draft should explicitly say that the unit ball is the unit ball B^n \subset \mathbb{C}^n.
It should make clear that the question concerns the \bar\partial-equation/operator on the domain \Omega itself, not merely the abstract complex structure.
No boundary regularity hypothesis should be added; the point of the problem is precisely that \partial\Omega may be very rough.

The paper's formulation appears intentionally informal, so the phrase "uniform estimates" should be preserved rather than replaced by a more specific norm estimate unless the paper itself specifies one.
If one wants the question to be fully stand-alone, one should state that n is arbitrary (or at least not fixed by the draft), rather than leaving the quantification over n implicit.

The draft does not explicitly identify whether the intended unknown is a function or a form solving \bar\partial u=f; because the source problem appears informal, the refined version should avoid over-specifying this unless the paper does.

Because this paper is a problem list rather than a theorem paper, there may be no numbered conjecture/proposition/theorem attached to this item; the refined question should therefore stay close to the informal wording instead of forcing a stronger formalization.
refined_question: Let \Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n be a bounded domain that is biholomorphic to the unit ball B^n \subset \mathbb{C}^n. Must the \bar\partial-equation on \Omega satisfy uniform estimates? The question is especially intended for the case in which the boundary \partial\Omega is very rough.
justification: The draft already matches the apparent target problem closely: it asks about bounded biholomorphic images of the unit ball and about uniform estimates for \bar\partial, and it flags rough boundary as the main source of interest. Because the source paper is a problem list, the safest paper-faithful refinement is to make the domain and notation explicit (B^n, \Omega \subset \mathbb{C}^n) while not inventing a sharper normed formulation of "uniform estimates" that the paper itself may not supply. Also, the developer instruction to prioritize Conjecture 1.1 / Proposition 1.2 / Theorem 1.3 does not fit this arXiv item: the accessible arXiv record shows that arXiv:math/9509202 is a problem list, not a theorem paper. I could verify the paper identity and its problem-list nature from the arXiv abstract page, but the PDF/source text was not retrievable through the available browsing interface, so page-level confirmation of the exact unlabeled item was not obtainable from the accessible source alone.
